data.title: Two Sum
data.statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume that each input has exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.
data.constraints:
Time complexity ≤ O(n), Space complexity ≤ O(n)
Game Mode
data.inputDescription:
Line 1: An integer n, representing the length of the array (2 ≤ n ≤ 10^4)
Line 2: n integers separated by spaces, representing the array elements (-10^9 ≤ element ≤ 10^9)
Line 3: An integer target, representing the target value (-10^9 ≤ target ≤ 10^9)
data.outputDescription: Output two integers separated by a space, representing the indices of the two numbers in the array (indices start from 0), sorted in ascending order

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume that each input has exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.
Input
Line 1: An integer n, representing the length of the array (2 ≤ n ≤ 10^4)
Line 2: n integers separated by spaces, representing the array elements (-10^9 ≤ element ≤ 10^9)
Line 3: An integer target, representing the target value (-10^9 ≤ target ≤ 10^9)
Output
Output two integers separated by a space, representing the indices of the two numbers in the array (indices start from 0), sorted in ascending order
Constraints
Time complexity ≤ O(n), Space complexity ≤ O(n)
Game Mode
Example
Input
123
Output
444
